description: Opposing facts with disjoint valid_at/invalid_at windows. Heuristic must NOT flag because invalid_at is set on one fact — temporally-windowed claims are not contradictions.

assertions.because: Facts with closed validity windows (invalid_at NOT NULL) must not be flagged as contradictions — they represent legitimate temporal succession

graduation_notes: Add temporal-overlap-active.sql: both facts active (invalid_at NULL) but valid_at ranges overlap — should flag because the heuristic can't infer temporal disjointness without explicit boundaries.
